evidence: Static contract (quality-checks.md #19 list), all satisfied on frozen bytes: (1) solution/solve.sh line 1 '#!/bin/bash', `bash -n` OK, `file` reports ASCII with 0 CR bytes (LF). (2) It writes only to /app: 'mkdir -p /app' and 'cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/' then removes only the DB triplet; it refuses a DB_PATH outside /app ('case ... /app/*) ;; *) ... exit 1'). No write to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution; grep for pkill|NODE_ENV|npm|curl|wget|/tests|/logs|/solution over solve.sh, server.js and src/*.js returns nothing. Superset of the template solve.sh (template is just mkdir + cp -a). (3) Entry: solution/app/server.js = "require('./src/index.js')"; package.json main server.js, start 'node server.js'; matches instruction.md:13 'start with node /app/server.js' and test.sh:97/111 'node "$APP_ENTRY"'. (4) DB_PATH honoured: db.js:9 'const DB_PATH = process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(__dirname, '..', 'app.db')'; bootstrap.js:45 passes '{...process.env, PORT: '0'}' to the worker so DB_PATH reaches it. test.sh:98-109 injects DB_PATH=/app/app.db (or /tmp/submission/app.db copy). (5) Idempotent seeding: db.js:61-62 'seedIfEmpty ... if (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) > 0 return' inside one transaction; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. (6) Self-contained: seed read from beside the module (db.js:10, __dirname), byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (both sha256 a1c65c80...7740), satisfying instruction.md:15 '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime' and hireops_rules.md section 8 (resolve files relative to module, not cwd); static UI via path.join(__dirname,'..','public') (index.js:42-43, 414). No node_modules shipped and no install: express 5.1.0 / better-sqlite3 12.4.1 come from NODE_PATH, installed in both environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile; instruction.md:13 'don't install packages'. 'Start with no shipped database': solve.sh deletes $database_path(-wal,-shm) after copy. (7) Port/health: bootstrap.js:43 listens on PORT||3000 on 0.0.0.0, and answers /api/health before the DB-opening worker is ready (bootstrap.js:20-25), matching integration.md 'GET /api/health answers before database work can block startup' and test.sh probe_ready. Restart: test.sh kills the process group (setsid); the worker thread lives in the same process, so no orphan holds the DB. Runtime evidence (hashes re-verified): workspace.cjs:16 launches 'node /app/server.js' with cwd '/tmp' and a minimal env {PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT, DB_PATH} as uid 65534 (per index scope), and workspace.cjs:378-386 SIGTERM-restarts over the same DB and asserts applications/activity/jobs unchanged (no reseed); results/workspace.json records that group 'passed': true; server.log shows two '[hireops] listening on 3000'. Adversarial probes: a broken reference that read /assets/seed_data.json at runtime or resolved files from cwd would fail the cwd=/tmp launch -- the golden does neither. A conforming agent alternative (own seed copy, different layout under /app, DB at DB_PATH) is not constrained by solve.sh and stays gradable, since test.sh only requires /app/server.js. Gaps keeping risk=true: solve.sh itself was never executed in recorded evidence (the scripted run populated /app by an unrecorded method; no Oracle/harbor run exists per raw-evidence-index scope 'Oracle/target scores are absent'), and the full test.sh launch path (setpriv + env -i + chown of /app) is not covered by a recorded configured verifier run for these bytes. Latent P3 observation only (not a defect): solve.sh's /proc fd scan throws on any readdir error other than ENOENT/ESRCH (e.g. EACCES if run non-root) but only when a DB already exists; a fresh Oracle container has none, so the scan exits 0 at its first check.
